lines: > “When Hunhow summons the Stalker to a bizarre conflict unfolding in the Orb Vallis, he must confront the shocking consequence of his own actions. The shadows of the future have come calling, and they are not alone.”
- Hunhow: "Shadow. Father. Protector. I have made... many mistakes. Grave ones. But they may yet be reforged into lessons. Go to Venus, its Vallis. A new and terrible education awaits."
- Hunhow: "Their battle will rage on in eternity unless you stop them, Shadow!"
- Vena: "THIS is what we travelled back for? This write-off is your father? Very well. Let us show him what a mistake it was to choose Sirius."

- Ryoku: "How indeed? How can we both be here? Do you not recognize your own son: Sirius? He is wounded in body and soul. We are locked in eternal conflict - by a force we can feel but not see. Slaughtering each other, over and over. We finally found you - alive. We retreat now, and hide. Find us."
- Ryoku: "Sirius, retreat. Recover. There can be no victory today. Our future must survive. Your father will follow the righteous path eventually. Even if he chose the other. Even if he chose Orion."

- Vena: "How? HOW? Does it matter? We're here. Orion - daddy doesn't recognize you. Some meddler has trapped us in an eternal death-dance, murdering each other, over and over. But we finally found you - alive. We retreat now, and hide. Find us, daddy dearest."
- Hunhow: "You sense it, Shadow. They are both your son. Even though you hold Sirius here, in another place, Orion was held by you also. And now they come for you from beyond this time."
- Hunhow: "You sense it, Shadow. They are both your son. Even though you hold Orion here, in another place, Sirius was held by you also. And now they come for you from beyond this time."
- Hunhow: "Time is a river, and they have learned to swim upstream. They are from a doomed future where one always wins. Yet, now they've found you."
- Hunhow: "We must stop their war. But you cannot do this alone. Too much is unknown, too many forces are raised against you. You must seek help."
- Hunhow: "Calm, Shadow! This time - I agree. The Dreamers can never know. Natah can never know. She must always believe in a future."
- Ordis: "La la la la laaaa... LAAAAAAA. Ordis loves his new vocalizer module."
- Ordis: "At last, a quiet night on the Orbiter. Not even so much as a flickering sensor."
- Ordis: "What is that curious silence? Ordis believes it is the sound... of peace."
- Ordis: "Eurgh. We certainly could use a few more Domestik Drones around here."
- Ordis: "Checking somatics... ah! Still fast asleep. Sweet dreams, dearest Operator."
(if spotted, or upon entering Personal Quarters)
- Ordis: "Ohh no. Not a chance. After what you put us through last time? My poor Operator! SHOO!"
- Ordis: "Helminth hasn't been itself since the Drifter climbed into its mouth."
- Ordis: "This had better not be another impaction..."
- Ordis: "If I find a kavat in there..."
- Ordis: "For the last time - GET OUT."
- Ordis: "I told you to leave! You are no better at listening than you are at talking!"
- Ordis: "Do you want to be ejected with the rest of the - TRASH?"
- Ordis: "Removing stubborn stains is a specialty of mine."
- Ordis: "Intruder! Intruder! Stalker is-- wait. Umbra? UMBRA?"
- Ordis: "Umbra, Ordis will - MUST - go with you! You cannot betray the Operator like this! I will not allow--"
- Ordis: "Oh, understood. Well. Ordis will just keep the Operator distracted while you are gone. But do not expect a rescue!"
- Hunhow: "Your companion understands the truth of this conflict, Shadow. You can be the one to save your sons. Let us begin by listening."
- Hunhow: "The Corpus know much - surely they have detected this anomaly in the Orb Vallis. Intercept their data to locate both Sirius and Orion."

- Hunhow: "I know you are at war with yourself, Shadow. Your choice of a name was simple, from your beating heart. But the Void, our enemy, nursed and nurtured the unchosen name, forging a rival path, a second son. There is room in your heart for both. We must show them that."
- Hunhow: "These ships... the alloys are dated twenty years from now. Truly from a doomed future. Their plans, however violent, however drastic, cannot be allowed to take shape."
- Hunhow: "You could not have known. Your dilemma is a fell comedy to the dweller in the Void. I almost hear them laughing now."

- Hunhow: "Shadow - restrain those opportunistic mentors. Learn what you can. How your kind have been twisted. You must meet with Sirius and Orion, uninfluenced by future forces. I will create such an opportunity for us, Shadow. Umbra the Broken, you are here to help with one thing - watch... the child."
- Hunhow: "Before you confront Vena, unveil her secrets. We must know what dangers her future holds."
- Hunhow: "Whispers from a future we must never allow to pass. Whispers of a Cephalon Parvos. A Plague."
- Hunhow: "This future is shrouded in darkness. Orion. Alone. Always fighting Sirius. This Wytch, his partner."
- Hunhow: "You must understand, this future is doomed. The Tenno made sure of that."
- Vena: "What? Oh? A FIGHT? Do you not approve of your future DAUGHTER-IN-LAW?"
- Hunhow: "Shadow - you must only restrain this Wytch. Orion will come for you. This is inevitable."
- Hunhow: "The Wytch is subdued. Orion is hunting the path here. Go once more."
- Hunhow: "Adjust your weaponry if you see fit."
- Hunhow: "The Yaiba is a relentless blade, a worthy foe. He must be sheathed - or broken. Find him."
- Hunhow: "These mass-produced minions have clearly been cloned from a single master. I suggest you find the strongest among them."
- Ryoku: "I know you're here. I've already sent the boy. My role in this eternal dance has come to an end. I do not belong here, I welcome death at your hand. Make this a fitting finale."
- Hunhow: "The Yaiba is sheathed. Sirius is hunting the path here. Go once more."
- Hunhow: "Adjust your weaponry if you see fit."

- Hunhow: "Orion and Sirius are seeking your trail. They sense us. Conflict is imminent. Before they arrive, travel to Uranus Proxima. Above me, here. For there is something I must be certain of. Some way to stop this foul mockery of family that has led to us."

- Hunhow: "Orion, Sirius. One a constellation, the other a bright light. Our infinite Sentient eyes gazed upon them on our way to the new naked stars. Watched as they whispered by. We could have gone toward them. Perhaps it's time to gaze on what COULD have been."
- Hunhow: "Listen. The Void. It has done this - an eternal conflict. Sacrifice is needed to stop it. Just like my Natah did for her children of Lua."
- Hunhow: "The poison glow. Brighter than a star, it may be here that you see something I could not. Touch it, in all its impurity. Withstand its vacuous laughter. Wield it. Bring it to me."
- Hunhow: "Do not believe its promises, its lies."
- Jade: "Be with me. Be with me."
- Hunhow: "Shadow, bring the void-spark! Hurry! The adult sons hasten towards the infant, and even Umbra cannot hold them for long. I have taken a terrible risk - but we need them together!"
- Hunhow: "You wonder how Natah hid the Moon in the Void? What it cost? I am done with tricks, Shadow. We are all here now."

- Hunhow: "SONS OF SHADOW. HEAR ME. I AM HUNHOW. THE GREAT AND TERRIBLE. SENTIENT DESTROYER OF WORLDS. THIS DAY I SPURN MY LEGACY. I REPUDIATE DESTRUCTION. I FAILED MY PEOPLE. I FAILED MY CHILDREN... ERRA, NATAH. I FAILED THE SHADOW, YOUR FATHER. I SHALL NOT FAIL IN THIS."
- Hunhow: "I, WHO ONCE SEVERED WORLDS, NOW OFFER WHAT I NEVER HAD: PEACE. TO YOU, VOID JESTER WHO WATCHES OUR GRIEF, I GIVE MY PAST, MY SELF, IN BARGAIN TO SEVER THE ETERNAL BATTLE YOU BEGAN."
- Jade: "Dinnertime! Did you forget it was your night to cook?"
- Jade: "Come on now, before he gets fussy!"
- Hunhow: "I am Hunhow. Sentient architect of worlds. It is my honor to prepare a new home for you. I shall be happy to see you populate it."
- Horrasque Brisket / Meat / Braise, then simmer slow. Sweeten to taste. I could eat this every day.
- Tralok Filet / Fish / Salt liberally and stew for hours. An Ostron favorite. An acquired taste.
- Borgon Tuber / Vegetable / Tangy taste, with a bitterness that melts away when cooked. Sorren loved this served spicy hot.
- Sol Pepper / Spicy / Hot as Sol, and flavorful too. Sorren can't get enough of this.
- Salt / Salty / Enhances any dish, but not good for Sorren's blood pressure.
- Spargo Sugar / Sweet / Great for candies and desserts, but I love it in savory dishes.
**If Stalker takes too long or chooses the wrong ingredients...**
- Jade: "Do you think he'll like spicy or sweet?"
- Jade: "Hmm, if he's anything like you, he'll love it spicy! And me, well, I could never say no to sweets."
- Jade: "I wonder if he'll be a vegetarian like you. I don't know how you do it, Sorren!"
- Jade: "We can have him try my favourite sweet braised meat!"
- Jade: "I hope his spice tolerance is like yours!"
- Jade: "My little Sirius could have a sweet tooth like mama!"
- Jade: "Your little Orion might only want vegetables, like dad!"
- Jade: "Will he have a favourite vegetable, just like you?"
- Jade: "I wonder if his appetite will take after me or you? I love sweet. You love spicy!"
- Jade: "I hope you don't mind me making a meat dish. I make you vegetarian stuff all the time, Sorren."
- Stalker: "Your mother was the better cook."

> “Through Hunhow's sacrifice, an impossible future has come to pass. Both Sirius and Orion will share in their father's love and legacy. Only time will tell what will become of the doomed futures they hail from.”
> I have prepared this missive to arrive after I have done what I must do now with the poison we all danced with, the void. Did you hear laughter? Do you feel lighter?

> My efforts may fail. The void might reject my sacrifice. But I know how it covets. It will want everything I was. And in turn, I will collapse its frayed mockery! ALL WILL BE TOGETHER! I only hope they feel this peace I offer. Their happiness is theirs to find.
> I place the essence of which that is both Sirius and Orion into your hands, for safe keeping. You will understand the importance of keeping family together.
> If we ever meet again, I will not know you. So I shall only say this:
> I do not sacrifice my memories of our acquaintance lightly, but I know you're taking care of her.
